Samir —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can deliver a scoped evidence package for an edge allocator that ties telemetry artifacts to CAIQ controls (especially CC6, CC7 and CE controls around logging and retention). Summary response below and next steps: 

1) Feasibility: Yes — we can produce a 7-day redacted sample export limited to one allocator (recommended). Size limit: ~500MB compressed; if you need smaller we can provide a sampled subset or pre-filter by endpoint or client-id.

2) Redaction & PII: We will apply deterministic hashing to identifiers and strip full-text user inputs where applicable. We will include a redaction log for the artifact.

3) Mapping: We will provide a CAIQ crosswalk doc that maps each artifact to the specific control (control id + short rationale).

4) Sampling plan & process: Kimberly will own the sampling plan and produce a one-page sample matrix and a short script that generated the export. Jonas will attach the runtime telemetry spec and examples.

Proposed schedule:
- 2027-09-20: Sampling plan + export script (kimberly)
- 2027-09-22: Dry-run export for internal review (jonas)
- 2027-09-24: Final evidence bundle to NebulaHealth (includes CAIQ mapping)

If that timeline works for you we will proceed. If you need the bundle earlier we can accelerate but may need to reduce sample size.

Best,
Priya Natarajan

Hi all —

Attached is the initial sampling plan and a trimmed runtime telemetry spec. Notes: 

- runtime-telemetry-specs.csv (attached) includes header columns and a small synthetic sample for fields we will export: timestamp, allocator_id, request_id_hash, trace_span, kv_event_type, kv_key_hash, event_size_bytes.
- kv-cache-sampling-plan.md (attached) describes criteria for selecting key-priming events (we keep high-frequency keys plus a stratified sample of tail keys). Sampling target: 2% of all kv-priming events over the 7-day window (to keep artifact size small while preserving distribution).
- Controls mapping draft: CC6.1 (logging collection), CC6.3 (log integrity & protection), CC7.2 (retention/TTL enforcement). I included short rationale lines in the markdown.

Export script: export_edge_telemetry.py (internal) — will run via our admin export job with parameters: allocator=<allocator_id>, start_date=2027-09-13, end_date=2027-09-20, redact=true, max_bytes=500000000. We will provide the script and execution log as part of the bundle.

Attachments: runtime-telemetry-specs.csv (csv), kv-cache-sampling-plan.md (md).

On redaction: we use HMAC-SHA256 with a per-customer salt stored in KMS; we will include the redaction algorithm description but not the salt.

LMK if Nebula needs different sampling thresholds or additional control mappings.

Thanks,
